output.architecture: React 19 + Vite 7 renderer (Electron file:// via frontend/dist/index.html) styled exclusively with hardcoded dark Tailwind v4 utility classes; there is no existing theme system, no prefers-color-scheme handling, and no semantic color tokens in components. App.jsx owns all screens: startupError/loading early returns (bg-[#0a0a0a]), JoinScreen (header bg-slate-950/55), and the meeting screen (root bg-[radial-gradient(...),#080a10], header bg-slate-950/70, sidebar bg-slate-950/80 hosting SummaryPanel/CaptionPanel/bench UI/SttStatusBar, VideoView tiles, floating MeetingControls bar bg-slate-950/75, SettingsModal overlay bg-black/80 with bg-[#111] panel titled 'Device Settings'). Persistence is renderer localStorage via App.jsx 'storage' helper (24h-expiry JSON wrapper; keys stt_config, llm_config, recent_rooms); Electron sets userData from ELECTRON_USER_DATA_DIR (desktop/main.js:14) with the default session, so localStorage persists per profile (scripts/run-electron-instance.js gives each dev instance its own tmp dir). Theme state must live in App.jsx and flow into JoinScreen (header toggle + SettingsModal), the meeting header (toggle), and SettingsModal (Appearance section + title change from 'Device Settings' to 'Settings'). Media areas that must stay dark: VideoView root bg-slate-950 + black overlay nameplates, JoinScreen preview container bg-slate-950 + bg-black/35|40 badges/control bar, and the MeetingControls bar. index.css ends with global 'input:focus, select:focus, button:focus { outline: none }', which conflicts with the visible-focus acceptance criterion; SummaryPanel already opts back in with focus-visible:outline-2 on some buttons. frontend tests are utility-only (captions.test.js -> mergeCaptions; llmModels.test.js -> normalizeLlmConfig); no component/DOM/integration test renders any screen, so no structural-count test assertions exist for the themed UI.
conventions: All styling is inline Tailwind utility classes; dark palette is hardcoded (bg-slate-950/*, bg-white/[0.03..0.07], text-white, text-slate-*, border-white/10), with arbitrary hex values bg-[#0a0a0a] and bracket opacities bg-white/[0.04]
Renderer persistence uses the App.jsx localStorage 'storage' wrapper (JSON with expiry) under snake_case keys: stt_config, llm_config, recent_rooms
Icons are individually named lucide-react imports (package lucide-react ^0.562.0 includes Sun/Moon)
Components are default-exported and wrapped in React.memo (JoinScreen, SettingsModal)
Visible-focus convention already exists in SummaryPanel via Tailwind focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-blue-400 on icon buttons
index.css carries global fixes: 'option { color: black; }' for native select listboxes and ':root' vars --background/--foreground/--border consumed by body
No formatter is configured; ESLint flat config errors on no-unused-vars with varsIgnorePattern '^[A-Z_]'; follow surrounding file style
frontend/src/App.css is dead boilerplate (never imported by main.jsx or App.jsx) and should not be touched
similarImplementations: frontend/src/App.jsx storage helper (lines ~38-60): the established persistence pattern to mirror for indefinite theme persistence
frontend/src/components/SummaryPanel.jsx focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-blue-400 buttons: the existing visible-focus convention to extend to the theme toggle

frontend/src/components/JoinScreen.jsx header right-side slot (lines 210-213, 'Audio local' pill) and App.jsx header right-side cluster (lines 734-760, STT pill / E2E pill / sidebar button): where the sun/moon quick toggle must be added
No existing theme implementation exists anywhere in the repo; light mode is net-new
commands: npx eslint <path> (run with frontend/ as working directory so its flat config resolves)
risks: No theme system exists: light styling requires either per-element Tailwind overrides across 8 JSX components or a CSS [data-theme="light"] override layer keyed on exact utility classes (class selectors must escape '/' and '[', e.g. .bg-white\/[0\.04]); a Tailwind --color-* variable remap is tempting but breaks gradient-button text (text-white on from-blue-500 to-violet-500 must stay white in both themes) and would invert dark media overlays

index.css global 'input:focus, select:focus, button:focus { outline: none }' and the modal <select> classes 'focus:outline-none' must be replaced with focus-visible rings to meet the WCAG AA visible-focus criterion
The storage helper defaults to a 24h expiry; storing the theme through it would not satisfy 'persist indefinitely' — a raw localStorage write or no-expiry variant is required

Loading and error states are separate early-return JSX blocks in App.jsx (lines 662-676) hardcoded bg-[#0a0a0a]; they must be included in light styling and the html/body background (index.css :root --background: #0f0f0f) must follow the theme to avoid flash on restart

WCAG AA on small labels: text-slate-400/text-gray-400 on near-white is about 2.9:1 (fails AA normal text); the light palette must darken muted text, and hover states like hover:bg-white/[0.08] hover:text-white need dark equivalents

Media areas (VideoView root bg-slate-950 with bg-black/45 nameplate, JoinScreen preview bg-slate-950 with bg-black/35|40 controls, MeetingControls bar bg-slate-950/75) must be explicitly re-darkened or excluded from light overrides
Passing new setTheme callback props into React.memo(JoinScreen)/React.memo(SettingsModal) bypasses memoization unless the callbacks are stable (useCallback)

No automated DOM/integration tests exist for the renderer, so acceptance criteria must be verified manually via npm run dev:local (two windows: npm run dev:two-electron); theme behavior has no test coverage
Native <select> dropdown listboxes are OS-rendered (like window chrome); only the existing 'option { color: black }' rule governs their text, so full control over that surface is limited
knownLessons: AGENTS.md: preserve 'base: "./"' in frontend/vite.config.js; Electron loads frontend/dist/index.html, not the Vite dev server
AGENTS.md: keep Electron capabilities behind the preload bridge; theme is pure renderer state (localStorage) so no preload/desktop change is needed
AGENTS.md: no formatter configured, follow surrounding file style; do not commit frontend/dist or benchmark output

AGENTS.md: update docs (README/TESTING/benchmark) only when setup commands, launch modes, or operational constraints change; the theme feature does not alter commands, so no documentation edit is required
docs/TESTING.md: renderer is not browser-standalone; verify the themed app through npm run dev:local (single instance) or npm run dev:two-electron (separate user-data profiles)
